# TokMarket

> TokMarket is a TikTok-style social marketplace where creators sell products, teach courses, and earn 90% of every sale with AI-powered listings and instant checkout.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover trending creators, products, and courses in a social feed.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse and buy products from independent creators.
- [Courses](/courses): Learn from creator-led video courses across categories.
- [Create a product](/create): List a new product with AI-generated copy.
- [Sign in](/auth): Log in or create a TokMarket account.

## Optional

- [Creator dashboard](/dashboard): Analytics and order management for sellers.
- [Manage courses](/manage-courses): Author and publish course content.
- [Wallet](/wallet): Points, balance, and payouts.
